---
title: "Map"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
#| message: false
world <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "lightgray") +
  geom_sf(
    data = mallards |>
      filter(lat >= 46, lat <= 55, long >= 7, long <= 25) |>
      st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326),
    aes(color = duck_id),
    size = 0.4
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(7, 25), ylim = c(46, 55)) +
  labs(
    color = "Duck",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    title = "Mallard GPS fixes in the study region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
